ticker_news.title: Down 10% After Fantastic Earnings, This Ultra-Cheap Stock Is a Screaming Buy
ticker_news.description: General Motors reported strong Q4 earnings and excellent 2025 guidance, but the stock fell 10% after the results. The company is executing well on its strategy, with impressive EV sales and a low valuation of just 4.3 times forward earnings. However, there are concerns about regulatory uncertainty surrounding tariffs and EV incentives.
ticker_news.author: Matt Frankel
